examples.name: Sample — buttons and a seal placeholder
paragraphs: Print, Save, Clear in coloured boxes at the foot, a grey notice beside them, and an empty box captioned [SEAL] at the left of item 5. Item 5 also nests a second row of options under d. The button labels and the [SEAL] caption are plain text.
